Unfortunately, once an order has shipped, we're no longer able to make address changes on our end. Per our [Shipping Policy (kb/02-shipping-policy.md)](kb/02-shipping-policy.md), address changes are **only possible before the order ships**. After shipment, you'll need to **contact the carrier directly** to request a delivery address update.

Here's how you can do that:
- **Find your carrier** from the tracking number in your shipping confirmation email.
- **Contact them directly** (e.g., UPS, FedEx, USPS, or Canada Post) and request an address change or package intercept/redirect — they may be able to assist depending on the shipment's current status.

If you need help locating your tracking number or identifying your carrier, feel free to share your order number and I can look that up for you!
